text:
leah.m: Reminder  rapid pen-test next Tue 09:30 PT. Need final scope and quick checklist: ephemeral RBAC, KMS presign exports, audit forwarding, retest tempo.

rahul.k: Propose a 90min RBAC window 08:30-10:00 PT. Keep an explicit approver list and require MFA for any emergency elevate.

jin.w: Presign lambda tested in staging. Flow: presign -> keystore-proxy -> kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext + Sign. We will NOT grant kms:Decrypt to assessor principals.

sam.t: Presign TTL 10m, bucket prefix `pt-exports/`, enforce x-amz-meta-request-id on objects. Ops: reserve a 3-4h retest slot 7 days after fixes; keep snapshots 72h.

leah.m: Intake must create triage tickets (project pen-2026-q2) with severity, repro, owner, flags: `requires-kms-review` and `rbac`. High+kms should page KMS SME.

rahul.k: I'll add label-to-pager mapping and the approver list. Also add a `requires-keystore-manifest` flag when keywrap state is relevant.

jin.w: I'll publish a compact runbook with: IAM/KMS policy snippet, presign lambda checklist, keystore snapshot command, and CloudTrail quick checks to verify no Decrypt calls from assessor principals. Example validation: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=Username,AttributeValue=assessor-external | jq '.Events[] | select(.EventName=="Decrypt")'`.

ops-bot: [ephemeral-bake] scheduled: ephemeral/assessor-bake-2026-07-12T07:00Z -> expires 2026-07-12T11:00Z.

sam.t: Also add an evidence checklist (screenshots, trace ids, snapshot manifest). That will speed retest verification.

leah.m: IR rule: if vendor executes an active exploit, escalate to oncall-SOC and open an incident in #incidents. That path is outside the normal retest flow. Include SOC contact card in runbook.

jin.w: Will post runbook + intake form link by EOD tomorrow.

rahul.k: Thanks  I'll draft the escalation mapping and GH webhook label rules.

leah.m: Action owners: Jin (runbook + form + presign policy), Rahul (escalation + labels + approvers), Sam (retest reservation + snapshot retention). Closing thread."
